title: Interesting News for Walmart Stock Investors | WMT Stock Analysis
creator: Parkevtate Vosianc CFA
summary: Parkevtate Vosianc updates Walmart after it bundled Walmart Plus with Sam's Club Plus at $120 a year plus tax, an annual-only offer pitched directly against Costco and Amazon Prime. He likes the move for shoppers — Walmart's wider assortment plus Sam's Club's warehouse range, at about Costco's executive-membership price — and expects significant consumer adoption, especially as stretched household budgets push shoppers toward the lowest-cost provider. Walmart's recovery since 2017 and its e-commerce gains earn praise, but same-store sales growth of just 2.6% in the latest quarter was its slowest since 2020. Valuation is the problem: Walmart trades at $118 on a forward price-to-earnings ratio of 36.5, more expensive than Amazon, against his discounted cash flow fair value of $69, about 40% overvalued. He reiterates that this is not a buying opportunity and would wait to buy, but downgrades his hold conviction from high to medium, saying the stock is approaching a sell and is closer to a sell than a buy. The call is WMT — HOLD, with conviction downgraded, a stance flip from his last tracked AVOID on 26 September 2026.

calls.thesis: Bundled Walmart Plus + Sam's Club Plus ($120/yr) is a good value move against Costco/Amazon, but the stock is too rich to buy here; hold conviction downgraded high -> medium and approaching a sell.
calls.base_case: Hold long-term could still give a reasonable return, but confidence is falling.
calls.bull_case: Bundle drives significant consumer adoption; e-commerce/marketplace gains continue.
calls.bear_case: Same-store sales growth slowest since 2020 (+2.6%); 36.5x forward P/E compresses; downgrade to SELL if overvaluation persists.
